title: New law: Reducing Flight Delays Act of 2013 (Public Law 113-9)
summary: H.R. 1765 of the 113th Congress became Public Law 113-9 on 2013-05-01.

title: New law: To specify the size of the precious-metal blanks that will be used in the production of the National Baseball Hall of Fame commemorative coins. (Public Law 113-10)
summary: H.R. 1071 of the 113th Congress became Public Law 113-10 on 2013-05-17.

title: New law: To award posthumously a Congressional Gold Medal to Addie Mae Collins, Denise McNair, Carole Robertson, and Cynthia Wesley to commemorate the lives they lost 50 years ago in the bombing of the Sixteenth Street Baptist Church, where these 4 little Black girls' ultimate sacrifice served as a catalyst for the Civil Rights Movement. (Public Law 113-11)
summary: H.R. 360 of the 113th Congress became Public Law 113-11 on 2013-05-24.
